title: Customizations editor
description: The Customizations editor (`AICustomizationManagementEditor`, `.ai-customization-management-editor`): a horizontal split with the section sidebar (Browse home button, then Plugins, MCP Servers, Skills, Instructions, Agents, Hooks, Tools with counts, a separator and Extensions) and the content pane for the selected section. It's the same editor whether it's hosted in the modal (`<vsc-modal-editor>`) or as a tab in the Agents window's docked editor part (`<vsc-agents-editor-part>`).
usage: Host inside <vsc-modal-editor> (the default Agents window experience) or <vsc-agents-editor-part> (useModal: off, docked right panel, where the sidebar sits at its 150px minimum). Give the host a height. Put one page per section in the default slot with a `section` attribute.

attributes.name: sidebar-width
attributes.description: Width of the section sidebar in px (200 default, 150 minimum, 350 maximum).

attributes.name: counts
attributes.description: Counts for Plugins, MCP Servers, Skills, Instructions, Agents, Hooks, Tools.

slots.description: Section pages (<vsc-customization-browse section="browse">, <vsc-customization-list section="skills">, …); only the page matching `section` is shown.

states.name: section-selected
states.trigger: Click a section row or the Browse home button; fires `section-change`.

examples.title: Section sidebar (Skills selected)
examples.html: <vsc-workbench window="agents" theme="dark-2026" style="width: 200px; height: 643px;"><vsc-customizations-editor section="skills" style="height: 643px;"></vsc-customizations-editor></vsc-workbench>

examples.title: Section sidebar (Browse selected)
examples.html: <vsc-workbench window="agents" theme="dark-2026" style="width: 200px; height: 643px;"><vsc-customizations-editor section="browse" style="height: 643px;"></vsc-customizations-editor></vsc-workbench>
